items.source: Note that the default behavior matches the traditional behavior in EJB CMT and JTA, with the latter having rollback rules similar to Spring. A global switch to trigger a rollback on any exception affects Spring's Transactional as well as Transactional but leaves the non-rule-based TransactionAttribute as-is.
items.translation: 请注意，默认行为与 EJB CMT 和 JTA 中的传统行为一致，其中后者的回滚规则类似于 Spring。全局开关用于在发生任何异常时触发回滚，该开关会影响 Spring 的 Transactional 以及 Transactional，但非基于规则的 TransactionAttribute 保持不变。

items.source: The default rollback-on behavior: rollback on RuntimeExceptions as well as Errors.
items.translation: 默认的回滚行为：在遇到 `RuntimeExceptions` 以及 `Errors` 时进行回滚。

items.source: The alternative mode: rollback on all exceptions, including any checked Exception.
items.translation: 替代模式：对所有异常执行回滚，包括任何受检的Exception。
